# FL3-C scheduling simulation reports (deterministic, CPU-only)

WP-C deliverables FL3-C1..C3 (branch `feat/fastlink-v3-network-sim`).

**Provenance.** Everything below is generated by the runner scripts in
`qa/` over the shared declared inputs in `qa/sim_common.py`:

```
cd qa
python3 sim_placement.py   # FL3-C1 placement matrix
python3 sim_pipeline.py    # FL3-C2 prefill/decode pipeline model
python3 sim_faults.py      # FL3-C3 fault injection + retry/timeout policy
# or, all three + the 91 model unit tests:
sh sim_run.sh
```

**Status: SIMULATED, NOT MEASURED.** Every number in these reports is
deterministic model arithmetic over *declared* planning inputs (device
capacities/occupancy, bandwidth rooflines, link rtt/throughput/queue,
workload shape). No GPU probe, benchmark, network capture, or telemetry
value is used, and none of these numbers may be quoted as a measured
result. The declared inputs themselves are estimates and are labelled as
such inside each output (see the assumption blocks). Verifying them
against real dual-GPU hardware is M3 work per docs/ROADMAP.md.

Key declared-input notes, so the output can be judged at all:

- Weights: 27.0e9 params x 4.7 bpw (declared Q4_K_M average) = 14.773 GiB;
  64 decoder layers; residual stream 4096 x 2 B = 8 KiB per boundary value.
- KV: 4096 B/token/layer at fp16 (declared GQA shape); q8/q4 KV modes are
  declared 0.5x/0.25x byte scales, not exact llama.cpp quant headers.
- Devices: RX 7900 XT 20 GiB with 800 GiB/s roofline; LOCAL_MIXED assumes
  6.0 GiB occupied (existing 27B service resident, per the mission board)
  -> 13.5 GiB placement budget after a 0.5 GiB workspace reserve, and
  LOCAL_DEDICATED assumes 0.5 GiB occupied -> 19.0 GiB budget. Remote
  RX 6600 XT: 1.0 GiB occupied + 1.0 GiB reserve -> 6.0 GiB budget at
  256 GiB/s roofline.
- Boundary hop (local<->remote): rtt 1.0 ms, 95.3674 MiB/s (1 Gbps at a
  declared 0.8 protocol efficiency), serialization 0.05 ms, queue 0.2 ms
  -- declared values, no real host addresses encoded anywhere.
- Prefill workload: 4096-token prompt streamed in 512-token ubatches
  (one RPC per ubatch per direction); decode: one residual-stream value
  per direction per token in the strict mode.

The verbatim outputs follow.

## FL3-C1 — VRAM-aware layer placement cost model

Acceptance: deterministic ranked placement matrix (layer split, prefill
and decode cost, transfer overhead). Ranking: feasible splits first by
decode tok/s descending, then infeasible splits by VRAM deficit so the
matrix also shows *why* a split fails.

```text

All values below are MODEL outputs from declared inputs. No GPU
probe, benchmark, or telemetry value is used. Declared inputs:
  workload            : 27B dense Q4_K_M-like, 131072-token ctx
  params              : 27.0 B x 4.7 bpw (declared) = 14.773 GiB weights
  layers              : 64 (split unit) | hidden 4096 x 2 B = 8.0000 KiB per boundary value
  KV/token/layer fp16 : 4096 B | KV modes: fp16=1, q8=0.5, q4=0.25
  prefill workload    : 4096 tokens, 512-token ubatches
  device              : LOCAL_MIXED: RX 7900 XT 20 GiB (existing 27B service resident) usable 14.0 GiB (-0.5 reserve -> budget 13.5), declared 800 GiB/s roofline
  device              : LOCAL_DEDICATED: RX 7900 XT 20 GiB (OS reserve only) usable 19.5 GiB (-0.5 reserve -> budget 19.0), declared 800 GiB/s roofline
  device              : REMOTE: RX 6600 XT 8 GiB usable 7.0 GiB (-1.0 reserve -> budget 6.0), declared 256 GiB/s roofline
  link                : LINK_REMOTE (boundary hop) rtt 1.0 ms, 95.3674 MiB/s, ser 0.05 ms, queue 0.2 ms (declared)
  local-side link     : used only for local disk->VRAM loading (modelled zero network cost)
```

## FL3-C2 — prefill-vs-decode pipeline model

Acceptance: numeric comparison of strictly synchronous steps versus
batched/pipelined independent RPC calls, assumptions stated.

```text
=== FL3-C2: prefill-vs-decode pipeline model (SIMULATED) ===
All values are MODEL arithmetic. Reference placement (from FL3-C1):
  split               : 53/11 layers local/remote, q4 KV, LOCAL_DEDICATED + REMOTE
  per-token compute   : local 15.293 ms + remote 9.919 ms = 25.211 ms/token (roofline)
  boundary per token  : 2.664 ms/token (2 directions x 1.332 ms: queue + rtt + ser + wire 8 KiB)
  strictly sync stream: dependency-chained, no overlap possible
  MODE B              : B independent streams share one RPC per
                        direction per step; KV stores x B. B_max
                        is VRAM-limited (C1 max_decode_streams).
  MODE P (ideal)      : both devices + link never idle; declared
                        UPPER BOUND, excludes scheduler/KV/sampler
                        overhead; >= 2 streams required.
  MODE UB prefill     : llama.cpp-RPC style: each ubatch waits for
                        the previous one end-to-end.
  MODE LM prefill     : two-stage pipeline, one fill/tail penalty.
  excluded            : host sampler, framework CPU time, queue
                        growth, thermal effects (all declared 0).

--- decode step model (single token) ------------------------
  local compute chain :     15.293 ms/token (54.9% of step)
  remote compute chain:      9.919 ms/token (35.6% of step)
  boundary RTTs       :      2.664 ms/token (9.6% of step)
  MODE S step latency :     27.875 ms/token ->   35.9 tok/s (strict sync, 1 stream)
  no-RTT compute floor:     25.211 ms/token ->   39.7 tok/s (RTT fully amortised asymptote)
  device roofline     :     15.293 ms/token ->   65.4 tok/s (pipelining cap: busier device)
  computed ceiling gap: batching/pipelining can recover at most 29.5 tok/s = 82%

--- decode batching: VRAM-limited B over context ------------
 ctx B_max | MODE S t/s | MODE B t/s   step ms | MODE P t/s  cycle ms | delta t/s
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
128K     1 |       35.9 |  n/a (B=1)         - |  n/a (B=1)         - |      +0.0
 64K     2 |       35.9 |       37.6      53.2 |       65.4      30.6 |     +29.5
 32K     4 |       35.9 |       38.5     104.0 |       65.4      61.2 |     +29.5

(B capped at 8 in the table; MODE P requires B >= 2 streams.)

--- prefill scheduling: 4096-token prompt -------------------
   ub rid |   total ms prompt t/s | LM total ms  LM t/s LM steady t/s | LM saving ms
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  256 UB |     103976       39.4 |       65222    62.8          65.4 |       +38754
  512 UB |     103956       39.4 |       67803    60.4          65.4 |       +36153
 1024 UB |     103946       39.4 |       72965    56.1          65.4 |       +30981
 2048 UB |     103941       39.4 |       83290    49.2          65.4 |       +20651
 4096 UB |     103938       39.4 |      103938    39.4          65.4 |           +0

Model note: ubatch-orthogonal, LM steady capture excludes fill;
LM total includes one fill/tail penalty (L + R + 2b cycles).
UB per-ubatch boundary is identical for every ubatch size because
the prompt streams the same bytes; only RTT counts differ.

--- computed conclusions (model arithmetic only) -------------
  1. Strict sync single-stream decode: 27.87 ms/token = 35.9 tok/s; boundary RTT share 9.6%.
  2. Batching shares one boundary RPC across B streams: gain bounded by the RTT share -> at most ~11% more tok/s.
  3. Two-stage pipelining (ideal) caps at the local device roofline 65.4 tok/s (82% over MODE S)
     and requires >= 2 resident streams: VRAM B_max is 1 at
     128K, 2 at 64K, 4 at 32K (q4 KV, k=53 split, modelled).
  4. Prefill (512-token ubatches): UB 39.4 tok/s -> LM 60.4 tok/s prompt (35% faster) by hiding
     the remote tail; remaining serial floor is the local roofline 65.4 tok/s steady.
```

## Computed selection recommendation (model arithmetic, not measurements)

1. **128K fp16 KV is infeasible for every split** in both device
   scenarios: the 32.0 GiB KV cache exceeds what two declared budgets
   (19.0 + 6.0 GiB, split proportionally to layers) can hold next to
   14.773 GiB of weights. 128K also fails with q8 KV and with q4 KV on
   the mixed-scenario 14 GiB card. The only VRAM-resident 128K placement
   in the model is q4 KV with a dedicated 7900 XT: splits 48..53, best
   53 local / 11 remote.
2. **Best feasible 128K split (53/11, dedicated, q4 KV):** decode
   27.87 ms/token = 35.9 tok/s, 39.4 tok/s prefill on a 4096-token
   prompt, 27.3 s remote weight cold load, 2.66 ms/token boundary
   overhead (9.6% of the step). If the local GPU stays mixed-service,
   the model's fallback is 64K q4 (splits 44..46, 31.1 tok/s) or 32K q8
   (44..46) / 32K q4 (42..51, 34.4 tok/s).
3. **Prefill is bandwidth-bound, not RTT-bound:** the residual streaming
   (2 x 8 MiB per direction) is 0.67% of the bubble-free UB-mode prefill
   total; the rooflines dominate. Scheduling order matters more: the
   layer-major two-stage pipeline recovers the remote-compute tail
   (39.4 -> 60.4 tok/s over the whole prompt, 65.4 tok/s steady; +35%).
4. **Decode pipelining is capped by the busier device:** batching can
   amortise only the 9.6% RTT share (up to ~11% tok/s); the idealized
   two-stage pipeline caps at the local roofline (65.4 tok/s, +82%) and
   requires >= 2 resident streams, which the KV budget only allows at
   64K (2 streams) and 32K (4 streams) with q4 KV. A single strictly
   autoregressive stream cannot overlap anything (dependency-chained).
5. **Fault behaviour:** a 1%-of-nominal boundary hop stretches the
   remote cold load from 27.3 s to 45.4 min and decodes down to 22.7
   tok/s; transient per-RPC loss up to p = 0.05 is fully covered by a
   retry budget of 2 (terminal failure prob p^3 = 1.25e-4 per RPC); a
   worker crash after c committed ubatches costs the in-flight ubatch
   in full, and resume-by-manifest saves 25.00..75.00% of the redo cost
   versus a full restart for c = 2..6 of 8 ubatches.
6. **Recommended policy (from the computed tables):** retries per
   transfer = 2 (3 attempts) for p <= 0.05; per-attempt timeout =
   max(50 ms, 3 x (queue + rtt + serialization + wire)) recomputed from
   the current link estimate (4 MiB ubatch: 130 ms nominal -> 12.59 s at
   1% link); disconnects: reconnect with (100, 400, 1600) ms backoff, at
   most 3 reconnects, then terminal abort with no partial output
   committed (v0.1 rule preserved); fallback placement under persistent
   degradation: all-local at <= 32K ctx with q4 KV, both from FL3-C1.
